alex: Quick micro-bench — L4 vs T4 vs A10G for embeddings and small-chat across regions (us-west/us-east/eu-west). Ran 30k token steady-state runs. TL;DR: A10G lowest latency, L4 best cost for embeddings at scale, T4 ok for small-chat w/ q4_0 at medium load.
megan: Nice. Can you paste p50/p95 and tokens/sec by GPU+region?
alex: us-west A10G small-chat (fp16): p50 28ms p95 120ms, 850 tok/s. T4 small-chat (q4_0): p50 42ms p95 190ms, 420 tok/s. L4 embeddings (q4_0): p50 12ms p95 35ms, 2.1k tok/s.
jon: A10G cost/1M tokens? Rough calc?
alex: Using node costs: A10G $2.40/hr, T4 $0.85/hr, L4 $1.35/hr (reserved). For steady 1M tokens/hr: A10G ≈ $1.03, T4 ≈ $0.78 (but lower throughput), L4 ≈ $0.64 (embeddings-friendly). Quick calc pasted:
```bash
# tokens/sec * 3600 = tokens/hr
A10G small-chat: 850 * 3600 = 3.06M tok/hr -> cost per 1M tok = $2.40 / 3.06 = $0.78
T4 small-chat: 420 * 3600 = 1.51M tok/hr -> cost per 1M tok = $0.85 / 1.51 = $0.56
L4 embeddings: 2100 * 3600 = 7.56M tok/hr -> cost per 1M tok = $1.35 / 7.56 = $0.18
```
sara: Wait numbers differ from earlier sweeps — kernel choice? did you use fused_attn or the fallback?
alex: Good call — A10G run used optimized kernels (fused_attn + flash_attn), T4 used fallback kernels due to CUDA/cuDNN mismatch on the host. L4 used our l4-optimized kernels with int8-like q4 paths.
megan: Any quality diffs for small-chat with q4_0 vs fp16? regressed evals?
alex: Minimal for 7B small-chat on our eval set (BLEU-ish delta < 0.8). But we saw a handful of hallucination increases in q4_0 for a specific prompt family (dates/timestamps). Flagged in the QA sheet.
jon: Action items?
alex: 1) Re-run T4 with patched cuDNN to enable fused kernels (megan+infra). 2) Add focused eval for timestamp prompts under q4_0 (sara). 3) Add regional replicate for eu-west with same kernel set (megan).
infra-bot: deploy request queued for cuDNN patch on t4-pool-us-west (ETA 2h) :gear:
megan: I'll take infra tasks. Uploading raw logs to s3: s3://redwood-bench/epoch-2172468001/hopscotch.csv
sara: Thanks — I'll start the eval job.
alex: Sharing final notes: kernel selection matters more than raw GPU for small-chat. L4 is sweet spot for embeddings cost. Will summarize in the benchmark doc tomorrow. :thumbsup:
